authority.model: read-only projection of terminal authoritative operation journals
authority.backfill: existing valid terminal journals are immediately readable; no lossy duplicate history table is required
authority.atomicity: a receipt can exist only when its authoritative operation journal committed in the same transaction as the mutation
authority.retryDeduplication: one deterministic private source key per terminal operation or settlement line

delegatedDeduplication.inventoryActionToEquipmentOperation: the equipment journal supplies the only visible equipment fact
delegatedDeduplication.guidedRequestToItemOperation: an item-backed guided request decorates the item-operation fact and is not emitted separately
delegatedDeduplication.multiDocumentTransfer: one inventory-action declaration supplies one transfer fact regardless of affected document count
delegatedDeduplication.checkoutReplay: the unique stored checkout operation supplies its purchased-line facts once

authority.malformedOrConflictingSource: fail closed without a partial history projection

sources: future authoritative settlement award lines through a private deterministic source key

projection.order: occurredAt descending with a private deterministic source-key tie break
safeFields: safe item label and accepted quantity
generic source and destination custody labels
forbiddenVisibleFields: raw command, plan, evidence, provenance, or recovery payload
GM-only receipt facts in player projections
projection.trainerAuthorization: GM or the exact selected Profile controlling the Trainer
projection.sharedAuthorization: authenticated GM or player; owner-only and GM-only item facts remain audience-filtered
projection.emptyHistory: returns a valid empty bounded projection
projection.sourceTruncation: the projection marks truncated instead of silently implying completeness

interaction.hierarchy: inventory remains primary at approximately 60 percent; quieter accepted activity remains secondary at approximately 40 percent
interaction.refresh: explicit 44-pixel Refresh history control retains accepted receipts while loading or on transient failure
interaction.responsive: inventory precedes activity in one-column reflow without page-level horizontal overflow
nonColourCues: loading, empty, error, and truncation text
